description: Template for an ez-appsec task plan. Each plan file is a JSON array of task objects that push-plans.py reads to create GitHub issues and project items.

plan_name.description: Human-readable name for this plan (e.g. 'Data Architecture v2')

repository.description: Target repository for branches and PRs (e.g. 'ez-appsec/ez-appsec')

tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks. Execution order matches array order. Dependencies reference earlier tasks by their 0-based index.

title.description: Short task title — becomes the GitHub issue title

description.description: Full task body in Markdown — becomes the GitHub issue body

labels.description: GitHub labels to apply (must exist on the repo)

depends_on.description: 0-based indices of tasks in this plan that must complete first

tasks.title: Extract widget interface
tasks.description:
## Goal
Define the widget interface.

## Done criteria
- [ ] Interface defined in `widget.py`
- [ ] Existing tests pass

## Done criteria
